## Summary

The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) has issued a notice informing trading members that several scrips previously suspended due to record dates for schemes of amalgamation will be officially delisted from the exchange effective October 12, 2026.

## Key Points

- Effective Date of Delisting: October 12, 2026.
- Affected Companies & Acquirers:
  - India Radiators Ltd. amalgamating into Mercantile Ventures Limited.
  - J.B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. amalgamating into Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited.
  - Sanghi Industries Ltd. amalgamating into Ambuja Cements Limited.
  - Wim Plast Ltd. amalgamating into Cello World Limited.
  - Gujarat State Petronet Ltd. amalgamating into Gujarat Gas Limited.
  - Sir Shadi Lal Enterprises Ltd. amalgamating into Triveni Engineering and Industries Limited.
  - Cigniti Technologies Ltd. amalgamating into Coforge Limited.

## Regulatory Changes

Formal removal of suspended scrips from the exchange trading platform following completion of corporate restructuring and amalgamation schemes.

## Compliance Requirements

Trading members are advised to take note of the delisting and ensure no further trading positions or settlements are entertained in the delisted scrip codes.

## Important Dates

- Notice Date: October 8, 2026
- Delisting Date: October 12, 2026

## Impact Assessment

Market participants and investors holding shares in the affected entities must refer to the respective scheme swap ratios and corporate action guidelines issued by the acquiring companies.
